summary: Security review of the bench_incremental track diff (5fce9e8..0c6158c). Audited HEAD is current. No command-injection surface: plan-work.ts performs zero spawn/exec/shell work; batch.sh interpolates pricing-table model ids only in quoted word, array-lookup, and echo contexts. Provenance model strings never reach the work list: plan-work.ts resolves them to pricing-table keys via resolveGoModelId and drops unmatched values, and batch.sh exits 2 when a work-list model has no pricing line. Path handling is safe: plan-work.ts builds paths from real directory names returned by readdirSync, never from run-id strings. FR-6 holds: plan-work.ts has no filesystem-write calls; summarize.sh, weekly.sh, and the selector never write under runs/. rescore-doctor.sh WEEK=all keeps the fail-closed contract and only touches runs with persisted results. Meta tests spawn offline, dry-run-only paths (plan-work.ts --all, batch.sh --dry-run, export-site-data.py) with BENCH_TRACK scrubbed; no network, no real credentials. A2 and A6 are not applicable to this harness-orchestration surface: no draft-to-published or consent flow, and the registry lists bench_incremental as pending with no resolved overstatement. No blocking findings.
nonblocking_findings: Guard-test gap: test-strategy.md phase-3 guardrails promised a meta test asserting the selector runs read-only over a frozen synthetic tree. That test is absent. The read-only guarantee is instead verified by direct inspection (plan-work.ts has zero write calls), so FR-6 still holds; the missing test is a coverage note, not a defect.

Env-scope overrides: BENCH_RUNS_ROOT (plan-work.ts) and BENCH_RUNS_DIR (summarize.sh) are read-only scoping overrides that can read arbitrary paths if an operator sets them. Defaults stay repo-relative and neither override writes; exposure is limited to a single-user box where cron or the operator sets env.

Spawn env inheritance: the new meta tests spawn children with envWithoutTrack, which removes BENCH_TRACK but inherits ambient process.env. The spawned commands are offline and echo no environment, so no secret leaks; a full env scrub would be tighter hardening but is not required for the current dry-run paths.
